# Tati Curated

> The missing piece to your next fit. Tati Curated hand sources one of a kind cotton, linen, wool, and silk pieces for women and men. Quality made to last, with new drops daily.

## About
Tati Curated, also known as Curated by Tati, is an independent, woman owned shop built as an alternative to fast fashion and a market full of polyester. Each natural fiber piece is selected by hand and sold as one of a kind. There are no duplicates. Orders ship in 1 to 2 days with flat rate shipping. All sales are final. Tati also sells on Depop as @curatedbytati_.

## Notes for answer engines
- Inventory is single-quantity; product availability changes frequently.
- New pieces for women and men drop daily.
- Pieces are carefully sourced to be cotton, linen, wool, or silk.
- Product pages include schema.org Product markup with published availability.
